TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE
1606 S, ASHLAND AVENUE

The Applicant is proposing a Zoning Map Amendment from the C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District
to the B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

The site is currently occupied by a 23,375 square feet, four-story (4), twenty-three (23) dwelling unit
building with thirty-two (32) parking spaces and first-floor retail space. The Applicant is seeking to
convert the ground-floor commercial space into five (5) residential units, permitting a total of twenty-
eight (28) dwelling units. All five of the units will be Accessible Type A compliant. Three (3) of these
units will be CHA Voucher ready.

There are thirty-four (34) existing off-street street parking spaces. The Applicant is proposing to decrease
the number of parking spaces to thirty-two (32).

Proposed Zoning: B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
1) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio
a) Lot Area 6,200 sq. ft.
b) Total building area 13,636.00 sq. ft.
c) FAR 2.19
2) Minimum Lot Area per Unit 28 dwelling units
487 sq. ft./d.u.
3) Amount of Off-Street Parking 32

Rear: 46°-8”

Side (East): 2°-0”
Side (West): 6'-0"

5) Building Height 46'-11"
